items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: one of the bands I had later on I remember I had George Cables play with me for quite some time.

ctx.x: With Roy McCurdy or with Louis Hayes?

Louis Hayes, Sam Jones. But I mean Roy McCurdy is a good friend. I love that band too. But all the bands were good, but it was just the way that Cannonball played, the way he approached the music. Everything, I mean the dance was in the music. That’s the key. When you heard Cannonball I mean it would get you dancing. The dance was in the music and everything they played sounded fun. It reached you. It hit you in the soul. And it was funny because one of the bands I had later on I remember I had George Cables play…

He did. He played like he was, I mean he just played with his personality almost. He just was so erudite and, that was great. Great stuff. What did you learn from people like Betty Carter and Dexter Gordon, that generation. Anything that you can pass on?
